pin_regs.reason: the data path is ONE register stage pin to pin (a / ya / yb -> 3:1 mux -> flop b, the relay-standard "flop = pin register" form, priced as 1 trunk stage by pv_trunk_gen); the 1-b y_valid pins and rst_n are registered at the pin in RTL; dla / dlb / ida / idb are die-top constants

job.purpose: PV pair RESULT TRUNK inject stage (RTL-BUILD-KV/PVTRUNK, pv_trunk_gen --result-trunk -> qkd_pvw_die_r, x16 per pair in the CT crossings): ONE 518-b register stage b <= inject a ? {ida,1,ya} : inject b ? {idb,1,yb} : a; the column y_valid pins are registered and count a compiled delay (dla / dlb, die-top constants) to the static inject slot; trunk a S -> b N, column 0 y on W, column 1 y on E; 108 x 108 pin-limited square (<= 6 pins / um on every face)
